concept_summary: Bills Online — a Flask web app (v2.0.26) for splitting monthly household utility bills among housemates. Each month is a billing period with dynamic bill components (Electricity, Water, Internet, Rent, ...) split by one of four methods: equal, usage (meter readings, tenths of kWh), percentage, or fixed amount. Supports redistribution rules (shift an excluded person's share to others by percent or fixed peso amounts), bill/meter photos (compressed, stored in DB), archive/unarchive of months, printable PDF export, reports (contribution pie, consumption trend, stacked kWh bars), a People Directory, and SQLite backup/restore with automatic schema upgrade. UI is the 'Industry' steel-blue design system, responsive, CSRF-protected.

approved_stack.framework: Flask (app factory pattern), served via uvicorn ASGI wrapper (asgi.py) in Docker; wsgi.py for dev
approved_stack.database: SQLite via SQLAlchemy, Alembic migrations (auto-upgrade on restore)
approved_stack.frontend: Jinja2 templates + vanilla JS + custom CSS ('Industry' design system), Lucide icons
approved_stack.testing: pytest + pytest-bdd (Gherkin, 277 backend tests) + Playwright (19 UI tests), ~88% coverage, 80% CI minimum
approved_stack.ci_cd: GitHub Actions: tests on PRs to main; on merge, patch-version bump + git tag + multi-arch image push to ghcr.io/phdwight/billsonline
approved_stack.deployment: Docker / docker compose, named volume for SQLite; fronted by Cloudflare Tunnel in production (chunked-body quirk handled by asgi.py buffering)

file_tree.app/: factory.py (app factory), config.py, extensions.py (db/migrate/csrf), models.py (7 SQLAlchemy models), repositories.py (data access), forms.py, version.py
file_tree.app/routes/: registration.py, home.py, admin.py, months.py (CRUD/readings/PDF), participants.py, components.py (+photos), adjustments.py, reports.py, settings.py (directory/backup/restore)
file_tree.app/templates/: base, index, month_detail, new_month, edit_month, archived, admin, participants, reports, settings
file_tree.tests/: bdd/ (backend, pytest-bdd + plain pytest), features/ (16 Gherkin files), ui/ (Playwright + Gherkin)
file_tree.root: main.py/asgi.py (ASGI), wsgi.py, Dockerfile, compose.yaml, requirements*.txt, VERSION, pytest.ini
